teams.axes: pos: metres, +X east, +Y north, +Z up, yaw counter-clockwise from above (fronts face -Y at yaw 0). pos_ue / yaw_ue: Unreal centimetres (x, -y, z) and degrees (-yaw).
teams.tags: every building actor: Selectable, Name:<kind>, Team:0|1|Neutral. Markers (TargetPoint actors): TeamStart:0, TeamStart:1, Rally:0, Rally:1, and the contested ground Basin, PassNW, PassSE.

balance.note: metres walked from the castle's door by the shortest route over the ground (50 cm cells, steps of at most 50 cm, no hazard, no building; trees not counted)

with_a_pass_shut.note: the route from the player's castle to the enemy's with a wall across that pass: None = there is none (no way round)

ground_m2.note: square metres. top / floor: the level ground itself; buildable: what of it can be walked to, less roads and buildings (and 2 m round them) and anything not level over 1.5 m; walkable_total: all the ground a unit can reach
